adversarial_battery.note: A6 (tampered anchor_bh) SUCCEEDS because the Clarity contract does not recompute anchor_bh on-chain — it only verifies the merkle proof. This is an honest architectural limitation (same as Starknet v1 contract). The anchor_bh is verified off-chain via the Python reference (parity proven). A7/A8/A13/A14/A15 are not enforced in the Clarity contract (relayer is trusted for header submission, similar to Starknet). A9/A20 are rejected by the Clarity type system at transaction construction time.

tamper_matrix.note: 4/5 mutations change anchor_bh directly (btc_address, block_hash, block_time, amount).
